theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.constant_weight_shift_one_residue {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (f : ℤ → R) :
(shiftOp 1 fun (x : ℤ) => 1)^[2] f (-2) = f 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.odd_shift_jet_monodromy_alternates {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (hk : Odd k) (c X : ℤ → R) (ε : R) (hX : Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.mono X = ε • X) (n : ℕ) :
Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.mono ((shiftOp k c)^[n] X) = ((-1) ^ n * ε) • (shiftOp k c)^[n] X

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_anticomm_mono_of_odd {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (hk : Odd k) (c f : ℤ → R) :
shiftOp k c (Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.mono f) = -Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.mono (shiftOp k c f)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_comm_mono_of_even {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (hk : Even k) (c f : ℤ → R) :
shiftOp k c (Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.mono f) = Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.mono (shiftOp k c f)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.jacksonT_residue_slot_zero {K : Type u_2} [Field K] (q : K) (f : ℤ → K) (hf : PowerSeriesSupported f) (n : ℕ) :
(jacksonT q)^[n] f (-2) = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.qddz_residue_slot_zero {K : Type u_2} [Field K] (q : K) (f : ℤ → K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
(qddz q)^[n] f (-2) = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.jacksonT_annihilatesConstants {K : Type u_2} [Field K] (q : K) :
AnnihilatesConstants 1 fun (e : ℤ) => QInteger.qIntBalZ q (e + 1)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.qddz_annihilatesConstants {K : Type u_2} [Field K] (q : K) :
AnnihilatesConstants 2 fun (e : ℤ) => QInteger.qIntBalZ q (e + 2)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.residue_slot_zero_shift_one {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (c : ℤ → R) (hc : AnnihilatesConstants 1 c) (f : ℤ → R) (hf : PowerSeriesSupported f) (n : ℕ) :
(shiftOp 1 c)^[n] f (-2) = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.residue_slot_zero_shift_two {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (c : ℤ → R) (hc : AnnihilatesConstants 2 c) (f : ℤ → R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
(shiftOp 2 c)^[n] f (-2) = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.annihilatesConstants_iff {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (c : ℤ → R) :
AnnihilatesConstants k c ↔ shiftOp k c (Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.monomialCoeff 0) = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_monomial_zero_off {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (c : ℤ → R) (e : ℤ) (he : e ≠ -k) :
shiftOp k c (Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.monomialCoeff 0) e = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_monomial_zero_apply {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (c : ℤ → R) :
shiftOp k c (Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.monomialCoeff 0) (-k) = c (-k)

Prop

Prop

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_residue_slot {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (c f : ℤ → R) :
shiftOp k c f (-2) = c (-2) * f (-2 + k)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_iterate {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (c f : ℤ → R) (n : ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
(shiftOp k c)^[n] f e = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, c (e + ↑i * k)) * f (e + ↑n * k)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_neg {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (c f : ℤ → R) :
shiftOp k c (-f) = -shiftOp k c f

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_smul {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k : ℤ) (c : ℤ → R) (r : R) (f : ℤ → R) :
shiftOp k c (r • f) = r • shiftOp k c f

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp_comp {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (k l : ℤ) (c d f : ℤ → R) :
shiftOp k c (shiftOp l d f) = shiftOp (k + l) (fun (e : ℤ) => c e * d (e + k)) f

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.ddz_eq_shiftOp {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (f : ℤ → R) :
Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.ddz f = shiftOp 2 (fun (e : ℤ) => ↑(e + 2)) f

theorem QOU.Mathlib.RamifiedShiftCalculus.shift2_eq_shiftOp {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (c f : ℤ → R) :
Brings.RamificationParityMonodromy.shift2 c f = shiftOp 2 c f

ℤ → R
